reader_summary.overview: What began as a scientific approach to creating and managing startups has now become a worldwide movement for companies of all sizes -- and for creating (or rather rediscovering) entrepreneurs in all places.. Not just inside startups, not just for software, and not just inside Silicon Valley. It's about unlocking human creativity everywhere.

key_points.text: What began as a scientific approach to creating and managing startups has now become a worldwide movement for companies of all sizes -- and for creating (or rather rediscovering) entrepreneurs in all places..
But has it become too much of a religion?
